newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $355 mln for the Tuesday, April 1.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $355 mln for the Tuesday, April 1.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Tuesday, April 1 are expected to total $355 million in 23 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $223 million in seven sales, with a $88 million Harris County, Texas, deal through Bear, Stearns & Co. Inc. topping the the list.
On the competitive side, 16 sales totaling $132 million are on the schedule, a $29 million Broome County, N.Y., deal at 1100 EST is the largest.
An additional 11 sales totaling $193 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Tuesday, depending on market conditions.
